newsitem.title: USA: Isidore now a hurricane in the eastern Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Isidore now a hurricane in the eastern Atlantic.

text.p: Tropical Storm Isidore turned into a minimal-strength hurricane in the open Atlantic early on Thursday after its winds rose to 75 mph (120 kmh), the National Hurricane Center said.
At 5 a.m. EDT (0900 GMT), Isidore was located about 725 miles (1160 km) west-southwest of the Cape Verde Islands in the eastern Atlantic, at latitude 11.8 north and longitude 34.7 west.
The storm was moving west-northwest at 15 mph (24 kmh) and was expected to strengthen, forecasters at the hurricane center said. It remained several days from land.
Hurricane force winds extended outward up to 30 miles (45 km) from the center.
Isidore is the seventh hurricane to form this season in the Atlantic.
